verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a vendor inventory or third-party vendor risk reviews. The cited material covers internal risk registers, risk assessment, assets, and outbound questionnaire and trust-center automation. These are adjacent features, not vendor inventory with security posture, data access, and review cadence, so they earn no credit. Vendor risk management is a fair axis for a compliance platform, so absence of evidence yields none, not na.

support.subject: As an operations lead, third-party vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform — security posture, data access, review cadence — instead of a spreadsheet
